ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms the analyzer command, enabled rules and failure handling are declared; it does not show the analyzer ran or found nothing.
offer: Choose correctness rules for the language and record the actual analyzer invocation. Analyzer crashes and findings remain non-passing; a missing analyzer is a setup gap.

minimal.reason: Record the exact analyzer command the repository runs. A missing command means a setup gap, not a clean result, so declare the real invocation.

mid.reason: List the correctness rules enabled for the language. An empty set analyzes nothing, so name the rule sets or checks in force.

maximal.reason: Set ignoring analyzer failure to false. A crashing analyzer must stay non-passing, otherwise a broken run reads as clean.

rule.reason: Record the exact analyzer command the repository runs. A missing command means a setup gap, not a clean result, so declare the real invocation.
